text:
incident-bot: :rotating_light: PagerDuty incident triggered -> service: inference-proxy-prod (sev2). Routed to: billing-team (unexpected). Incident URL: https://pagerduty.com/incidents/PD12345

pagerduty-bot: Alert details: 
- Trigger: 5xx rate spike from inference-proxy-prod
- Start: 2026-03-15T09:34:38Z
- Current status: triggered (unacknowledged)

Alex Romero: I just got the page. acknowledging now.
Alex Romero: acked the PD incident — taking primary.

Sasha Li: wait why is inference-proxy-prod routed to billing-team? that team shouldn't have that service attached.
Sasha Li: last PD sync job ran at 03:00 UTC. I didn't see any manual bindings.

Tanya Burke: quick customer-impact check: Maya, can you confirm which customers saw errors?

Maya Patel: support-run: querying logs now. preliminary: 5 customer tenants had 503s between 09:31-09:35 UTC, spike ~09:34. All on hosted-api region-us-west-2. Tickets: #C-4491, #C-4492 started hitting support.
Maya Patel: update: customers affected are two fintechs and three startups — severity moderate, paying customers complaining about timeouts.

Ethan Cole: pulling PD service config: running pd-cli svc get inference-proxy-prod

``` 
Service: inference-proxy-prod
Integrations: pagerduty-webhook, alert-router
Escalation Policy: infra-escalation
LinkedSchedules: billing-team, infra-oncall
```

Ethan Cole: looks like billing-team is accidentally linked as a secondary schedule. might be from the policy import script 2026-03-14.

Jason Kim: I can unbind billing-team from the service but we need to be careful with automatic imports. who approved the import?

Sasha Li: that import came from `infra/rotations/sync` PR merged yesterday by automation. rule used tag `critical-payment` for matching and someone added billing-team to match set — bad predicate.

Priya Nair: OK action plan: (1) immediate mitigation = remove billing-team from escalation so correct oncall gets pages; (2) fix import rule and revert bad PR; (3) notify affected customers and raise incident page; (4) postmortem. Alex keep leading on incident channel.

Alex Romero: executing mitigation step 1 now. Jason, can you confirm you have privilege to edit PD service? I'll wait before escalating.

Jason Kim: I have perms. unbinding now...done. PagerDuty shows linkedSchedules: infra-oncall only.

pagerduty-bot: Change log: Removed schedule 'billing-team' from service 'inference-proxy-prod' by Jason Kim at 2026-03-15T09:38:12Z

Alex Romero: nice. re-routing should stop extra noise. I'll set PD incident to 'acknowledged' and set assignee to infra-oncall.

pagerduty-bot: Incident PD12345 assigned to infra-oncall, status: acknowledged.

Tanya Burke: while Alex handles triage, Ethan can you patch the import script? change the matching predicate to exclude `team:billing` and add a unit test.

Ethan Cole: on it. quick diff I pushed to branch fix/pd-import-exclude-billing. snippet:
```
- match_tags = ["critical-payment", ...]
+ match_tags = ["critical-payment"]
+ exclude_teams = ["billing-team"]
```
Ethan Cole: deploying a hotfix to the syncer now. Should prevent recurrence on next scheduled run.

Maya Patel: customer comms: drafting a short note — apology + rollback confirmation. Priya, want to review before we send?

Priya Nair: yes please. include ETA for full RCA. keep it honest: "paging misroute caused by schedule import, pages to unintended team; mitigation applied; working on root cause."

Alex Romero: root cause triage so far: service binding included wrong schedule due to overly-broad tag predicate in import job merged 2026-03-14. Impact: misrouted pages to billing-team and transient 503s for a subset of tenants due to upstream throttling while autoscale warmed up.

Sasha Li: re: throttling — we saw a queue backlog when proxies retried on initial failures. autoscaling delay ~90s. scaling tweak suggestion: lower cool-down for proxy autoscaler during weekdays.

Jason Kim: I'll submit a config change to scale cooldown from 120s -> 60s, but we should run that through canary first.

Ethan Cole: hotfix deployed to syncer (v1.3.4-hotfix). also added unit test to CI that verifies billing-team excluded. CI green.

Alex Romero: incident status: mitigation applied, pages routed correctly, affected customers still investigating but errors subsided around 09:37 UTC. setting incident to resolving once confirm no new pages in next 10m.

Maya Patel: support update: customers all report recovered. three support tickets updated with status/resolution.

Priya Nair: good. next steps: (A) revert PR that introduced the broad predicate and create a follow-up to audit other import rules; (B) run a PD binding sweep to detect unexpected schedule links; (C) postmortem and action owners assigned.

Alex Romero: assigning action items: Jason -> PD binding sweep by EOD; Sasha -> autoscaler cooldown canary by tomorrow morning; Ethan -> merge hotfix to main + deploy; Priya -> lead postmortem and customer comms review; Maya -> close customer tickets with note.

Priya Nair: thanks all. tagging severity: Sev2 -> downgraded to Sev3 for internal tracking since no data loss, transient outages only. will run 1-hour postmortem at 14:00 UTC.

incident-bot: Incident PD12345 moved to status: resolved at 2026-03-15T09:47:20Z by Alex Romero (notes: billing-team unbound, syncer hotfix deployed, customers recovered).

Alex Romero: closing thread here. if anything new pops up ping me directly. :thumbsup:
